content:
A Laredo woman was arrested early Tuesday, November 4, after police say she was driving a stolen Corvette toward Mexico at an international bridge.

Yareli Guadalupe Sanchez, 27, was arrested at about 1:48 a.m. on November 4 at an international bridge, according to the Laredo Morning Times.

The Corvette had been reported stolen out of Houston, and the plates on the vehicle were fictitious and did not match the car's vehicle identification number, according to the report.

Sanchez was arrested by Laredo police, according to the report. She is presumed innocent unless proven guilty in court.

Sources: Laredo Morning Times, “LPD: Woman arrested for driving stolen Corvette toward Mexico,” November 4, 2026.
